newsitem.title: USA: Dollar scales fresh 29-month peak vs mark in U.S..
newsitem.headline: Dollar scales fresh 29-month peak vs mark in U.S..

text.p: The dollar rocketed briefly to a new 29-month high against the German currency, powered by belief that U.S. economic growth picked up in the final period of last year, experts said.
The dollar first surged to 1.5904 marks in the U.S. and then retreated. Shortly afterwards, it rose to 1.5913 marks.

David Ethridge, director of currency analysis in North America at MMS International, said investors are now coming to terms with the fact that fourth-quarter U.S. economic growth definitely accelerated from the slowdown in the second and third.
"And even though there is a recovery in Europe and in Japan, the issue is the recoveries seem to be fairly fragile...," Ethridge added.
